text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Sakura Bakushin O has a
number
of victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm in my office sifting through some files
when
the hot spring coupon Sakura
Bakushin O got
from the raffle happen
to slip out. That reminds
me—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Should there come a time in society
where class
representatives are made
obsolete by their
exceedingly exemplary
status, then I'll visit the
hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't make much sense of those
words back
then, but with the expiry
date fast approaching, I
decide to at
least give them to Sakura Bakushin
O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That was my intention at least...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see... So the time has finally come!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It is true that as of late society has
changed for
the better! Well, things
have quieted down at
least.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To give you an example, I've noticed I
spend all
my lesson time sitting in
complete silence!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In conclusion! Let us head to the hot
spring with
Bakushin haste!
choice_data_list: （単に居眠りしているからでは？）

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This hot spring inn is simply
magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Swept up by her Bakushin-like vigor, I
find myself
standing outside the inn with
only the clothes I'm
wearing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is what an inn should be, how
exemplary!
What a refined taste! It's fit
for a class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer, let's head inside right
away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
First splash water over yourself to warm
up. Once
you're clean, then you can go
in!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to follow the rules! That's the
trick to
enjoying your time here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Phew... The water was wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I feel shiny from head to toe! Hey, don't
you think
I'm glowing after my dip?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Looks like going to the hot
springs
really does have a super
Bakushin effect on your
skin.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I'm this smooth, surely it has an effect
on my
speed?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This calls for an experiment! Hm...
Where else can
you find speed at the
hot springs—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A game of table tennis! Trainer, I'm
taking you on!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No problem! You don't have to worry
about
working up a sweat here!
choice_data_list: 上がったばっかりなのに！？

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's get in a long workout and then
take another
good soak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make the most of the inn's facilities
with Sakura
Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I may be a perfect class
representative in
every regard, but this
certainly has worn me out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I've had this much fun since
the time
I first decided to become class
representative...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
When a trip has activities like this, who
better for
the job than a class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I put some extra oomph in my running
today,
even more than I do for my class
representative
duties...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's nice to relax and let my hair down
once in a
while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, a world that has no use for
class
representatives is like a solar
eclipse.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The time when the sun, or the class

representative, is hidden is exceedingly
short.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Soon enough I will return to my post. I
must
remain exemplary at all times for
that very
purpose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll walk out of this hot spring glossy and
smooth,
and make my comeback as a
new, powered-up
class representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'd like that to happen, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In order to guide my classmates down
the right
path, I must understand their
feelings... Such as
why they like to goof
around so much...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's why the most exemplary course of
action
would be to hang out with you
more!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: R-right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I continue to enjoy my time at the inn
together
with a very rambunctious
Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Sakura Bakushin O and I
have formed
an irreplaceable bond
during this time together.
